summary: Replaces libarea/kurve arc fitting with a Clipper2 z-metadata approach, removing the Profile JoinType/MiterLimit properties, the Area feature's Offset/Pocket configuration properties (JoinType, EndType, MiterLimit, RoundPrecision, Thicken) and several libarea properties (ClipFill, Simplify, CleanDistance, Unit, MinArcPoints, MaxArcPoints), plus the Path.ClipperJoinType* scripting constants.

pages.reason: Path/Op/Profile.py: areaOpProperties drops the JoinType enumeration and MiterLimit float properties (hidden in the editor, but listed in the page's property table) and areaOpOnDocumentRestored removes them from existing documents

App/FeatureArea.cpp: PARAM_PROP_ADD for AREA_PARAMS_OFFSET_CONF and AREA_PARAMS_POCKET_CONF removed, and App/AreaParams.h drops ClipFill, Simplify, CleanDistance, Unit, MinArcPoints, MaxArcPoints; the Offset group (JoinType, EndType, MiterLimit, RoundPrecision), Pocket Thicken and those libarea properties no longer exist on the Area feature
App/AppPathPy.cpp removes Path.ClipperJoinType* constants and PathScripts/PathUtils.py drops the getOffsetArea joinType kwarg, but the page describes Path.Area only generically without these names
Path/Op/Deburr.py: switches to offsetWireCompat and keeps the Side handling; fixes wrong-side cutting (#29824) with no property or option change
libarea/AreaPocket.cpp and App/Area.cpp only invert the internal Offset sign convention and replace OffsetWithClipper calls; no pocket property, default or pattern changes
App/FeatureArea.cpp hunk only affects the Area feature constructor; Path.fromShapes() usage on this page does not name the removed area parameters
App/FeatureArea.cpp: only FeatureArea's constructor changes; the workplane feature is untouched
Path/Op/Base.py and PathScripts/PathUtils.py hunks remove the unused opExecute return value and getOffsetArea kwargs; nothing the overview describes
Path/Op/Base.py hunk is an internal return-value cleanup unrelated to start point selection
Path/Op/Base.py hunk is an internal return-value cleanup; drilling untouched
